resources.string: This low-strain demo treats a uniform collagen bundle as linearly elastic under axial tension. It does not model a whole tendon, ligament, or individual cell. It omits nonlinear behavior and time-dependent viscoelasticity. Inputs are synthetic, not personal measurements. Outputs do not identify injury thresholds or provide training or medical advice.
ΔL = F L / (E A)\nAxial strain (%) = 100 × ΔL / L\nF: tensile force (N); L: original length (mm); E: elastic modulus (N/mm²); A: cross-sectional area (mm²). Elongation ΔL is in mm.
